The most straightforward one‑step synthesis is a Heck coupling between an aryl halide (bromobenzene) and a vinyl cyclobutanol bearing a trifluoromethyl group. Both bromobenzene and the required vinyl cyclobutanol are commercially available and inexpensive (well under $250 total). The retrosynthetic tree therefore consists of a single reaction node (Heck coupling) connecting these two precursors to the target.</thought>
